text:
Plan all 24 Atlas modules: returns, tenant, shipping, checkout, webhooks, search, archive, alerts, scheduler, pricing, session, notify, billing, feed, inventory, ingest, export, audit, profile, upload, gateway, media, sync, backup. Use only the final values below; earlier drafts are withdrawn.

Values: inventory.queue_depth=280; tenant.queue_depth=50; webhooks.retry_limit=6; webhooks.timeout_s=95; session.ttl_s=480; alerts.batch_size=850; profile.batch_size=500; returns.queue_depth=240; notify.queue_depth=410; upload.queue_depth=500; search.timeout_s=95; search.retry_limit=5; feed.retry_limit=5; archive.timeout_s=85; media.max_workers=26; backup.max_workers=12.

Limits (conditions already met): alerts.queue_depth≥480; export.timeout_s≥115; sync.queue_depth≤20; ingest.max_workers≤2; inventory.max_workers≤4; pricing.retry_limit≤1; profile.ttl_s≤90; shipping.max_workers≤4.

Fixed owners: alpha: audit, backup, search, export. delta: returns, profile. beta: tenant, upload.
Apart: gateway/profile, alerts/checkout, billing/feed, media/tenant. Together: tenant/webhooks, audit/export, search/archive, backup/scheduler.

Dependencies (A→B: A depends on B): billing→webhooks, billing→tenant, search→audit, upload→gateway, pricing→shipping, archive→checkout, ingest→export, sync→pricing. Forbidden paths (A→B): checkout→feed, inventory→sync, archive→webhooks, session→webhooks.

Run order (A→B: A first): gateway→audit, gateway→shipping, shipping→backup, shipping→session. Optional: gateway.ttl_s≈330; pricing on alpha. Everything else is the team's call.

Files (file→owner): rules.py→returns, locks.py→tenant, bench.py→shipping, handlers.py→sync, specs.py→backup, parser.py→backup, events.py→media, retry.py→gateway.
